rationale: S-0070-02 proposes building a unified model-bed-runner library exposing Bed A and Bed B behind one Python API. Pure infrastructure work — high quality-of-life value but not blocking any current experiment. The two new tasks commissioned in this brainstorm (t0074 channel tuning-width sweep and t0075 biologically-realistic AIS one-axis sweep) both run on Bed A only, and the cross-bed harmonisation question (S-0070-01) is itself ahead of the unified-runner question in the dependency chain. Reprioritising from high to medium so the high-priority shelf reflects the experiments actually on the critical path.
